But I couldn't find a maven.pkg.github.com reference in the build files. The buildlogic plugin jar is the actual build script — let me inspect it and look for a repository configuration. I can use `strings` on the extracted class files.

No wait, let me check the Gradle module metadata (.module file). It might contain repository information… no, metadata doesn't include repositories.

Let me grep the class files of the extracted jar for "maven.pkg.github.com" and "token". The jar contains compiled Kotlin classes; if the string is embedded in the code, the string constant should show up via `strings`.
